text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"opens with a clear anti-driverless-car claim","quality":"clear thesis","description":"The essay states a definite position at the start so the reader immediately knows what it is arguing."},{"evidence":"adds examples like \"lay back and relax\" and \"construction cites or accidents\"","quality":"development","description":"The essay explains its stance with more elaboration and supporting points instead of only naming facts."},{"evidence":"\"Now on the other side of the argument\" followed by counterpoints","quality":"counterargument","description":"The essay acknowledges the opposing view and responds to it rather than arguing only one-sidedly."},{"evidence":"\"Learning to drive... developes certain skills\" and \"This shows great responsibility\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay connects evidence to a broader claim about why driverless cars are undesirable."},{"evidence":"closing lines about keeping skills and not letting \"robots take over everything\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a stronger final statement that reinforces its main argument."}]}
